premises.text: Indoor growers' sensor notes and yields are siloed raw data that force guesswork, consultant spend, or gut decisions
premises.evidence_span: this is raw data. It doesn't talk to each other, and it doesn't tell Tom anything

premises.text: AgriList aggregates greenhouse data in one place via sensor sync, document upload, and manual entry with dashboards and graphs
premises.evidence_span: AgriList can automatically sync with any hardware he has in the equipment, like sensors. He can upload documents. And he can even enter data manually

premises.text: Task management surfaces harvest/seed work and yield risks so growers can alert sales and adjust growing cycles
premises.evidence_span: Agoralyst also acts as a task manager, showing Tom what he has to do on a day-to-day basis

premises.text: Energy recommendations tell growers when to turn lights on/off against time-varying electricity rates to cut costs
premises.evidence_span: provides recommendations to show Tom when he should turn on and off his lights to achieve maximal savings

premises.text: Sold as a subscription priced per acre per month to indoor greenhouse growers in a large growing market
premises.evidence_span: Our private beta was released at a subscription price at $1,000 per acre per month

value.text: Help indoor farmers take control of operations, eliminate guesswork, save money, and grow better
value.evidence_span: a platform that helps indoor farmers take control of their operations

secondary_value.text: Feed the world more sustainably via efficient indoor growing
secondary_value.evidence_span: We want to help feed the world

causal_links.evidence_span: all of Tom's data talks to each other, eliminating the guesswork from decision making
Agilis analyzes and makes recommendations for Tom, saving him money
With AgriList, it's a lot easier

notes: ASR variants AgriList/Agoralyst/Agilis kept in evidence spans verbatim. Sensor list (lighting, temp, CO2…) folded as context for siloed data pain. Singletons D2 and D3 justified as separately revisable recommendation module and pricing.
